Definition: of foreign origin; Elymas, a wizard:--Elymas.
BiblicalUsage: Elymas is a wizard. In Acts 13:8, the text says "But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them." The life behind the name is told on the Elymas People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Elýmas matters because God knows His people by name, and Elýmas is one of them. That is why I want the name, and the person behind it, kept straight.
RelatedEvents: Paul's Missionary Journeys; Elymas Blinded on Cyprus
